mock_data.title: Parental Aspirations
mock_data.passage:
Educational qualifications are considered to be very important in the modern world. They are essential for people who want to find reasonably well-paid employment in the professions. For this reason, most parents try to get their children to work hard at school and achieve academic success by doing well in exams. Many parental aspirations also include their children going to university and graduating with a good degree.

Not all children, however, are capable of achieving academic success. This does not matter as long as parents are willing to accept this, but it is quite common for parents to think that all their children have to do is to study hard and they will pass their exams. All too often, they just succeed in causing too much stress in their offspring, with the result that the children either get ill or fail exams that they might otherwise have passed.

There are some children who are quite bright, but who are simply not interested in formal learning. Some might be of an artistic bent and wish to become an artist or designer while some might have a talent for acting. Others may show an aptitude for working with their hands, or want to start their own businesses and become entrepreneurs.

It is perfectly possible for children to achieve such ambitions. However, their parents may well have other ideas, which can lead to family conflict. Strangely enough, many parents are often reluctant to allow children to follow in their footsteps. For example, actors may not wish their children to have a career in the theatre, because of the uncertainty of the profession. Business people may feel that their children will have more status in an academic profession than in the world of commerce.

The opposite situation also arises. Parents who have worked hard to establish a business may want their children to become part of it, only to find that their sons and daughters prefer to look for completely different occupations.

Each generation has different ideas, making communication between the two extremely difficult. Thus, has arisen the aptly named generation gap.
mock_data.passageB1:
In today's world, having good qualifications is very important. They are needed to get good jobs that pay well. Because of this, most parents want their children to study hard at school and do well in their exams. Many parents also hope their children will go to university and get a good degree.

However, not all children can get good grades. This is okay if parents accept it. But often, parents think that if their children just study hard, they will pass. This can cause a lot of stress for the children. As a result, they might get sick or fail exams they could have passed.

Some children are smart but not interested in formal learning. Some might be artistic and want to be an artist or designer. Others might be good at acting. Some might be good with their hands, or want to start their own businesses and become entrepreneurs.

It is possible for children to achieve these goals. But their parents might have different ideas. This can cause conflict in the family. It's interesting that many parents don't want their children to do the same job they do. For example, actors might not want their children to work in the theatre because it's not a certain job. Business people might think their children will have more status if they work in a school or university instead of in business.

The opposite can also happen. Parents who have worked hard to build a business might want their children to join it. But the children might want to find completely different jobs. Each generation has different ideas. This can make it hard for them to talk to each other. This is why we have something called the generation gap. It is difficult for people of different age groups to understand each other.
mock_data.passageB2:
In today's world, educational qualifications are widely considered paramount. They are almost essential for securing well-paid jobs in professional fields. Consequently, most parents try to encourage their children to study diligently and achieve academic success by performing well in exams. Many parents also aspire for their children to attend university and graduate with a respectable degree.

However, not all children have the aptitude for academic success. This is perfectly acceptable, provided parents can accept it. Unfortunately, it's common for parents to believe that hard work alone guarantees exam success. Too often, they simply create excessive stress for their children, potentially leading to illness or exam failure that could have been avoided. This can undermine their children's confidence and well-being.

Some children may be intelligent but simply lack interest in traditional schooling. They might possess an artistic inclination, wishing to become artists or designers, or they might have a talent for acting. Others may demonstrate a knack for practical work or a desire to start their own businesses and become entrepreneurs. It's entirely possible for children to fulfil these ambitions. However, their parents may have different ideas, which can cause family conflict. Interestingly, many parents are hesitant to let their children follow in their own footsteps. For instance, actors might discourage their children from pursuing a career in theatre due to the precarious nature of the profession. Business owners might believe their children would gain more prestige in an academic field than in the business world.

The opposite situation also occurs. Parents who have worked hard to establish a business might want their children to join it, only to find that their children prefer entirely different careers. This can lead to disappointment and misunderstanding. Each generation tends to have different perspectives, making communication between them incredibly challenging. This is the genesis of what is commonly known as the generation gap, a phenomenon that can strain family relationships. Bridging this gap requires empathy and a willingness to understand each other's viewpoints, allowing children to pursue their own paths while maintaining strong family bonds and mutual respect.
mock_data.passageC1:
In contemporary society, educational qualifications are widely regarded as paramount, functioning as a key determinant for securing reasonably remunerative employment, particularly within professional sectors. Consequently, a prevailing aspiration among parents is to instill in their children a robust work ethic and a commitment to academic excellence, with the ultimate goal of achieving notable success in examinations. Indeed, many parents harbour ambitions for their offspring to pursue higher education, culminating in the attainment of a prestigious degree.

However, it is crucial to acknowledge that not all children possess an innate aptitude for academic pursuits. This divergence in capabilities is not inherently problematic, provided that parents demonstrate a willingness to accept and accommodate these differences. Regrettably, a common pitfall lies in the parental assumption that diligent study alone guarantees exam success. Such an approach can, all too frequently, precipitate undue stress and anxiety in children, potentially leading to illness or, paradoxically, undermining their performance in examinations they might otherwise have passed. The pressure can take its toll.

Furthermore, a subset of children, while possessing considerable intellectual capacity, may simply lack interest in traditional, formal learning environments. Some may exhibit a natural inclination towards artistic expression, aspiring to careers as artists or designers, while others might demonstrate a talent for performing arts. Still others may reveal an aptitude for manual trades or harbour entrepreneurial ambitions, seeking to establish their own businesses. It is perfectly feasible for children to realise such aspirations, but such is not always met with family support.

The realisation of these alternative ambitions is entirely viable; nevertheless, parental preferences often diverge, potentially leading to familial discord. Ironically, many parents display a reluctance to permit their children to follow in their footsteps. For instance, actors may dissuade their children from pursuing theatrical careers, citing the inherent instability of the profession. Similarly, entrepreneurs might believe that an academic vocation offers their children greater social standing than the world of commerce. This can give rise to conflict.

Conversely, the opposite scenario also frequently arises. Parents who have dedicated considerable effort to establishing a successful business may desire their children to assume a role within it, only to discover that their sons and daughters are drawn to entirely different professional paths. Each successive generation tends to embrace distinct perspectives and ideologies, thereby rendering meaningful communication between them exceedingly challenging. It is from this divergence that the aptly named generation gap stems from.

mock_data.translation:
Hozirgi dunyoda ta'lim darajasi juda muhim deb hisoblanadi. Ular professional sohalarda (professions) munosib maoshli ish topishni xohlaydigan odamlar uchun zarurdir. Shu sababli, aksariyat ota-onalar farzandlarini maktabda qattiq o'qishga va imtihonlarda yaxshi natijalarga erishib, akademik muvaffaqiyatga (academic success) erishishga majbur qilishadi. Ko'pgina ota-onalarning intilishlari (aspirations) farzandlarining universitetga borishi va yaxshi diplom bilan uni tamomlashini (graduating) ham o'z ichiga oladi.

Biroq, hamma bolalar ham akademik muvaffaqiyatga erishishga qodir emas. Agar ota-onalar buni qabul qilishga tayyor bo'lsalar, bu muhim emas, lekin ota-onalar ko'pincha farzandlari faqat qattiq o'qishlari kerak va ular imtihonlardan o'tishadi deb o'ylashadi. Ko'pincha, ular faqat o'z farzandlarida (offspring) haddan tashqari ko'p stress keltirib chiqarishga muvaffaq bo'lishadi, natijada bolalar kasal bo'lib qolishadi yoki aks holda o'tishi mumkin bo'lgan imtihonlardan yiqilishadi.

Ba'zi bolalar juda aqlli, lekin ular shunchaki rasmiy ta'limga qiziqishmaydi. Ba'zilari badiiy qobiliyatga (artistic bent) ega bo'lishi va rassom yoki dizayner bo'lishni xohlashi mumkin, ba'zilari esa aktyorlik iste'dodiga (talent) ega bo'lishi mumkin. Boshqalar qo'l mehnati bilan ishlashga moyillik (aptitude) ko'rsatishlari yoki o'z bizneslarini boshlashni va tadbirkor (entrepreneurs) bo'lishni xohlashlari mumkin.

Bolalar bunday ambitsiyalarga (ambitions) erishishlari mutlaqo mumkin. Biroq, ularning o'rinli ota-onalarida boshqa g'oyalar bo'lishi mumkin, bu esa oilaviy nizoga (conflict) olib kelishi mumkin. Ajablanarlisi shundaki, ko'plab ota-onalar ko'pincha bolalarining ularning izidan borishiga (follow in their footsteps) ruxsat berishni xohlamaydilar. Masalan, aktyorlar kasbning noaniqligi sababli farzandlarining teatrda ishlashini xohlamasliklari mumkin. Tadbirkorlar esa o'z farzandlarining tijorat (commerce) olamidagiga qaraganda akademik kasbda ko'proq mavqega (status) ega bo'lishlarini his qilishlari mumkin.

Buning aksi ham bo'ladi. Biznesni yo'lga qo'yish uchun qattiq mehnat qilgan ota-onalar farzandlarining uning bir qismi bo'lishini xohlashlari mumkin, lekin faqat o'g'illari va qizlari butunlay boshqa kasblarni (occupations) izlashni afzal ko'rishlarini bilib olishadi.

Har bir avlodning har xil g'oyalari bor, bu esa ular o'rtasidagi muloqotni (communication) nihoyatda qiyinlashtiradi. Shunday qilib, o'rinli ravishda avlodlar o'rtasidagi farq (generation gap) deb nomlangan holat yuzaga keldi.

inclination.uzbek: Muayyan tarzda harakat qilish yoki his qilishning tabiiy tendentsiyasi.

mock_data.translationB1:
Bugungi kunda yaxshi malakaga ega bo'lish juda muhim. Ular yaxshi maosh to'laydigan yaxshi ishlarni topish uchun kerak. Shu sababli, ko'pchilik ota-onalar farzandlari maktabda qattiq o'qishlarini va imtihonlardan yaxshi o'tishlarini xohlashadi. Ko'plab ota-onalar, shuningdek, farzandlari universitetga borib, yaxshi diplom olishiga umid qilishadi.

Biroq, hamma bolalar ham yaxshi baho ololmaydi. Agar ota-onalar buni qabul qilsa, bu yaxshi. Ammo ko'pincha, ota-onalar agar farzandlari qattiq o'qisa, imtihondan o'tadi deb o'ylashadi. Bu bolalar uchun juda katta stressga olib kelishi mumkin. Natijada, ular kasal bo'lib qolishi yoki o'tishi mumkin bo'lgan imtihonlardan yiqilishi mumkin.

Ba'zi bolalar aqlli, ammo rasmiy ta'limga qiziqmaydi. Ba'zilar badiiy bo'lishi va rassom yoki dizayner bo'lishni xohlashi mumkin. Boshqalar aktyorlikda yaxshi bo'lishi mumkin. Ba'zilarning qo'llari yaxshi ishlashi yoki o'z bizneslarini boshlashni va tadbirkorga aylanishni xohlashlari mumkin.

Bolalarning bu maqsadlarga erishishi mumkin. Ammo ularning ota-onalari boshqa fikrlarga ega bo'lishi mumkin. Bu oilada nizolarni keltirib chiqarishi mumkin. Ko'pgina ota-onalar farzandlarining o'zlari qiladigan ishni qilishini xohlamasligi qiziq. Masalan, aktyorlar farzandlarining teatrda ishlashini xohlamasligi mumkin, chunki bu aniq ish emas. Biznesmenlar farzandlarining biznesda ishlash o'rniga maktab yoki universitetda ishlashsa, ularning maqomi yuqori bo'ladi deb o'ylashlari mumkin.

Aksincha holat ham bo'lishi mumkin. Biznes qurish uchun ko'p mehnat qilgan ota-onalar farzandlarining unga qo'shilishini xohlashi mumkin. Ammo bolalar butunlay boshqa ish topishni xohlashlari mumkin. Har bir avlodning o'z fikrlari bor. Bu ularning bir-biri bilan gaplashishini qiyinlashtirishi mumkin. Shuning uchun bizda avlodlar o'rtasidagi tafovut degan narsa bor. Turli yosh guruhlarining bir-birini tushunishi qiyin.
mock_data.translationB2:
Bugungi kunda ta’lim darajalari nihoyatda muhim deb hisoblanadi. Ular professional sohalarda yaxshi maoshli ishlarni ta’minlash uchun deyarli zarurdir. Shu sababli, ko‘pchilik ota-onalar farzandlarini tirishqoqlik bilan o‘qishga va imtihonlarda yaxshi natijalarga erishish orqali akademik muvaffaqiyatga erishishga undashga harakat qiladi. Ko‘pgina ota-onalar farzandlarining universitetga kirishini va hurmatga sazovor diplom bilan o‘qishni tugatishini orzular qiladi.

Biroq, hamma bolalarda ham akademik muvaffaqiyatga erishish qobiliyati yo‘q. Agar ota-onalar buni qabul qila olsalar, bu butunlay maqbuldir. Afsuski, ota-onalar faqatgina qattiq mehnat imtihonlarda muvaffaqiyatni kafolatlaydi, deb hisoblashlari odatiy hol. Ko'pincha ular shunchaki farzandlari uchun haddan tashqari stress yaratadilar, bu esa oldini olish mumkin bo'lgan kasallik yoki imtihondan yiqilishga olib kelishi mumkin. Bu ularning farzandlarining ishonchini va farovonligini zaiflashtirishi mumkin.

Ba'zi bolalar aqlli bo'lishi mumkin, lekin shunchaki an'anaviy maktabga qiziqishi yo'q. Ular rassom yoki dizayner bo'lishni xohlab, badiiy moyillikka ega bo'lishi mumkin yoki aktyorlik qobiliyatiga ega bo'lishi mumkin. Boshqalar esa amaliy ishga usta bo'lishlari yoki o'z bizneslarini boshlash va tadbirkor bo'lish istagini namoyish etishlari mumkin. Bolalarning ushbu maqsadlarni amalga oshirishi butunlay mumkin. Biroq, ularning ota-onalari boshqacha fikrda bo'lishlari mumkin, bu esa oilaviy nizolarga olib kelishi mumkin. Qizig'i shundaki, ko'pchilik ota-onalar farzandlarining o'z izidan borishiga ikkilanishadi. Masalan, aktyorlar farzandlarini kasbning nozik tabiati tufayli teatrda karyera qilishdan qaytarishi mumkin. Biznes egalari farzandlari biznes olamiga qaraganda akademik sohada ko'proq obro'ga ega bo'lishiga ishonishlari mumkin.

Qarama-qarshi vaziyat ham sodir bo'ladi. Biznesni yo'lga qo'yish uchun ko'p mehnat qilgan ota-onalar farzandlarining unga qo'shilishini xohlashlari mumkin, lekin farzandlari butunlay boshqa karyerani afzal ko'rishlarini aniqlaydilar. Bu umidsizlik va tushunmovchilikka olib kelishi mumkin. Har bir avlod turli nuqtai nazarga ega bo'lishga moyil, bu esa ular o'rtasidagi muloqotni nihoyatda qiyinlashtiradi. Bu odatda avlodlar tafovuti deb ataladigan hodisaning boshlanishi bo'lib, bu oilaviy munosabatlarga putur etkazishi mumkin bo'lgan hodisadir. Bu tafovutni bartaraf etish hamdardlikni va bir-birining nuqtai nazarini tushunishga tayyor bo'lishni talab qiladi, bu esa bolalarga kuchli oilaviy rishtalarni va o'zaro hurmatni saqlagan holda o'z yo'llaridan borishlariga imkon beradi.

Zamonaviy jamiyatda ta’lim darajasi keng tarqalgan holda o‘ta muhim deb hisoblanadi va ayniqsa, professional sohalarda munosib daromadli ish topishning asosiy omili bo‘lib xizmat qiladi. Natijada, ota-onalarning asosiy orzusi – farzandlariga qattiq mehnatsevarlik va akademik mukammallikka sodiqlikni singdirish, yakuniy maqsad esa imtihonlarda sezilarli muvaffaqiyatga erishishdir. Haqiqatan ham, ko'plab ota-onalar farzandlarining oliy ma'lumot olishini va nufuzli diplomga ega bo'lishini xohlashadi.

Biroq, barcha bolalarning ham akademik mashg'ulotlarga tug'ma qobiliyati yo'qligini tan olish muhimdir. Qobiliyatlardagi bunday farq ota-onalar bu farqlarni qabul qilishga va moslashishga tayyor ekanliklarini ko'rsatsa, muammo emas. Afsuski, ota-onalarning faqat tirishqoqlik bilan o'qish imtihonlarda muvaffaqiyatni kafolatlaydi, degan noto'g'ri taxmini keng tarqalgan xato hisoblanadi. Bunday yondashuv juda tez-tez bolalarda asossiz stress va tashvishni keltirib chiqarishi mumkin, bu esa kasallikka olib kelishi yoki paradoksal ravishda, ular o'tishi mumkin bo'lgan imtihonlardagi ko'rsatkichlarini pasaytirishi mumkin. Bosim o'z ta'sirini ko'rsatishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, bir qator bolalar, sezilarli intellektual qobiliyatga ega bo'lishiga qaramay, an'anaviy, rasmiy ta'lim muhitiga qiziqmasligi mumkin. Ba'zilarida rassom yoki dizayner sifatida martaba qilishga intilib, badiiy ifodaga tabiiy moyillik bo'lishi mumkin, boshqalari esa sahna san'atiga qobiliyatini namoyon qilishi mumkin. Yana boshqalari qo'l mehnati kasblariga qobiliyatini ko'rsatishi yoki o'z biznesini yo'lga qo'yishga intilib, tadbirkorlik ambitsiyalarini namoyon qilishi mumkin. Bolalar bunday intilishlarni amalga oshirishi mumkin, ammo bu har doim ham oilaning qo'llab-quvvatlashiga ega bo'lmaydi.

Ushbu muqobil maqsadlarga erishish butunlay mumkin; shunga qaramay, ota-onalarning afzalliklari ko'pincha farq qiladi, bu esa oilaviy kelishmovchiliklarga olib kelishi mumkin. Ajablanarlisi shundaki, ko'plab ota-onalar farzandlariga o'z yo'llaridan borishga ruxsat berishni istamaydilar. Masalan, aktyorlar farzandlarini teatr karerasidan qaytarishi mumkin va bu kasbning beqarorligini sabab qilib ko'rsatishi mumkin. Xuddi shunday, tadbirkorlar akademik kasb farzandlariga tijorat olamiga qaraganda yuqori ijtimoiy mavqeni taklif qiladi, deb hisoblashi mumkin. Bu narsa kelishmovchilikka sabab bo'lishi mumkin.

Aksincha, teskari ssenariy ham tez-tez uchraydi. Muvaffaqiyatli biznesni yo'lga qo'yish uchun katta kuch sarflagan ota-onalar farzandlarining unda rol o'ynashini xohlashi mumkin, ammo o'g'il-qizlari butunlay boshqa kasblarga qiziqishini aniqlaydilar. Har bir keyingi avlod o'ziga xos nuqtai nazarlar va mafkuralarni qabul qiladi, shu bilan ular o'rtasida mazmunli muloqotni o'ta qiyinlashtiradi. Aynan shu farqdan avlodlar o'rtasidagi tafovut kelib chiqadi.
